words.example: Her improvement plan sets three concrete goals for next month.
words.exampleZh: 她的改进计划为下个月定了三个具体目标。

words.meaning: 绩效改进计划（Performance Improvement Plan）
words.example: HR put him on a PIP (Performance Improvement Plan) after the review meeting.
words.exampleZh: 考核会之后，人力资源把他纳入了绩效改进计划。

words.example: Her probation review falls on the last Friday of May.
words.exampleZh: 她的试用考核定在五月的最后一个周五。

words.example: Her exit interview is set for two o'clock this Friday.
words.exampleZh: 她的离职面谈定在本周五两点。

words.example: Please go through the handover checklist with her on Thursday.
words.exampleZh: 请在周四和她一起把交接清单过一遍。

words.example: An unsigned binary in the temp folder tried to start on the registration PC.
words.exampleZh: 挂号电脑的临时目录里有一个未签名程序试图启动。

words.example: Add the viewer vendor as a trusted publisher so updates install without a prompt.
words.exampleZh: 把阅片厂商加为受信任发布者，更新就可以不再弹提示。

words.example: SmartScreen warned on the dictation installer because the download was rare.
words.exampleZh: 这个听写安装包很少有人下，智能筛选因此弹了警告。

words.example: Defender quarantined the installer on the registration PC before anyone opened it.
words.exampleZh: 有人打开之前，系统防护已经隔离了挂号电脑上的那个安装包。

words.example: ASR (Attack Surface Reduction) blocked Office from creating a child process on the billing PC.
words.exampleZh: ASR（攻击面减少）阻止了收费电脑上的 Office 拉起子进程。
